target.title: fix(msteams): strip internal tool-trace banners from outbound text
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Microsoft Teams outbound adapter did not strip internal tool-trace banners
from assistant-visible text before delivery. Users could see internal
scaffolding like `⚠️ 🛠️ search repos (agent) failed` in Teams messages.

## Why This Change Was Made

Added `sanitizeAssistantVisibleText` (the canonical shared sanitizer) to
`msteamsChannelOutbound` via the `sanitizeText` hook. This matches the fix
already applied to tlon (#103450) and synology-chat (#102925).

## User Impact

**Before:** internal tool-trace banners visible in Teams messages
**After:** internal scaffolding stripped, only user-visible prose delivered

## Evidence

Branch: `fix/msteams-sanitize-outbound` | Base: `upstream/main`

### Real behavior proof

Delivery-pipeline proof: `deliverOutboundPayloads` (the shared delivery
entry point) drives the msteams channel with a captured send dependency.
The test verifies tool-trace banners are stripped BEFORE the send boundary
and trace-only payloads are suppressed:

```
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/msteams/src/outbound-tool-trace-sanitize.test.ts --reporter=verbose

 ✓ sanitizes tool-trace banners from outbound text before the send boundary (#103692)
 ✓ suppresses trace-only outbound payloads before the send boundary (#103692)
 ✓ preserves clean prose through the send boundary (#103692)

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  3 passed (3)
```

### Regression tests

Channel-level tests verify the sanitizeText hook is correctly registered
and strips tool-trace banners, memory tags, and trace-only payloads:

```
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/msteams/src/channel.test.ts --reporter=verbose

 ✓ advertises sanitizeText that strips internal tool-trace banners from outbound text
 ✓ sanitizeText returns empty string for trace-only replies
 ✓ sanitizeText strips memory tags from outbound text
 ... 16 more passing ...

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  19 passed (19)
```

### Diff summary

```
extensions/msteams/src/channel.ts                           | 2 ++
extensions/msteams/src/channel.test.ts                      | 26 +++++++++++
extensions/msteams/src/outbound-tool-trace-sanitize.test.ts | 103 +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
```

What was not tested: live Microsoft Teams transport (requires a registered
Teams bot with Azure Bot Framework). The delivery-pipeline test exercises
the shared `deliverOutboundPayloads` entry point with a captured send
dependency — the same proof pattern accepted for tlon (#103450).

- [x] I understand what the code does
- [x] Change is focused and does not mix unrelated concerns
